shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- src ---\\n' && find src -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort && printf '\\n--- index ---\\n' && cat index.html && printf '\\n--- vite ---\\n' && cat vite.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg \"export .*Title|declare function .*Title|type TitleProps|const Title\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -30 && rg \"FlexProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/import { Button, Flex, Text, Title }/import { Button, Flex, Text }/; s/<Title level={2}>/<Text variant=\"header-1\" as=\"h2\">/g; s/<\\/Title>/<\\/Text>/g' src/pages/*.tsx
sed -i 's/import { Button, Card, Flex, SegmentedRadioGroup, Text, Title }/import { Button, Card, Flex, SegmentedRadioGroup, Text }/; s/<Title level={3}>/<Text variant=\"header-1\" as=\"h3\">/g; s/<\\/Title>/<\\/Text>/g' src/App.tsx
sed -i 's/align=\"center\" justifyContent=\"space-between\"/alignItems=\"center\" justifyContent=\"space-between\"/; s/align=\"center\"/alignItems=\"center\"/g' src/App.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/import { Flex, Text, Title }/import { Flex, Text }/; s/import { Flex, List, Text, Title }/import { Flex, List, Text }/; s/<Title level={2}>/<Text variant=\"header-1\" as=\"h2\">/g; s/<\\/Title>/<\\/Text>/g' src/pages/*.tsx
sed -i 's/justify=\"space-between\"/justifyContent=\"space-between\"/g' src/App.tsx
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --stat && git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/App.css && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import shutil
shutil.rmtree('dist')
PY
git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true});\" && git status --short"
